text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a ~3x spike in WS reconnects for EU after last night's proxy rollout. Reconnects mostly show 'early_close' client-side. Anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: ws-proxy v2.13 -> canary 20% -> 2026-03-19T22:14:05Z :rocket:

kian: yep saw that. Console shows jump around 22:18 UTC. Sampling logs show tcp FIN from proxy after ~28s idle.

sam: could be our keepalive vs proxy idle mismatch. Proxy config uses idle_timeout=30s; client keepalive is 60s.

jess: that's the rollout we merged for connection pooling. It intentionally drops idle sockets at 30s to free upstreams.

maria: problem is resume logic on client retries and billing side — we get duplicate resume attempts that create extra billing tokens.

kian: telemetry gap: resume_id is opaque and not propagated through the proxy logs. console counts reconnects but we can't correlate to session ids.

sam: can we add an annotated header from proxy -> runtime? e.g., X-Proxy-Session: <opaque> so we can dedupe in billing.

jess: adding headers is doable but needs privacy review. Also impacts caches.

maria: short-term fix: change client keepalive to 20s to keep connections alive -> but that'll increase load. Not ideal.

kian: alternative: make proxy wait 5s before tearing to allow client heartbeat. e.g., idle_grace=5s.

sam: we should also add sampling in console to show reconnect origin (proxy, client, network). propose new metric: streaming.reconnect_origin{kind="proxy|client|network"}

jess: +1. Can we emit origin using the TCP close reason and resume headers? I'll sketch change.

maria: also add dashboard card with 95th percentile of time-to-reconnect and per-tenant rate. current card is too coarse.

kian: query I'd use for quick-check:

``
sum(rate(stream.reconnects[5m])) by (region, tenant)
``

and filter by reason:

``
sum(rate(stream.reconnects{reason="early_close"}[5m])) by (region)
``

sam: action items: (1) jess add origin tag in proxy logs (canary) (2) kian add sampling metric + dashboard panel (3) privacy to review header idea (4) temp adjust proxy idle_grace to 5s for EU canary

jess: started canary patch branch: github.com/redwood/ws-proxy#pr-842

deploy-bot: Rollout: ws-proxy v2.13.1 canary -> EU (updated idle_grace)

maria: monitoring now, asking SRE to watch billing deltas. thanks. :pray:

kian: note: if privacy blocks header, fallback is token dedupe in billing using short time window (30s) + IP+tenant heuristics.

sam: I'll add a low-rate log sample with resume headers to help dedupe for now.

maria: Filed ticket: INF-1934 with these actions. ping @people-ops for visibility.

jess: will follow up with patch review tomorrow.

maria: closing thread when metrics stable, will update here. :eyes:
